dct_title_s: Nepal Flood 2026: fAIr Damage Assessment, Upper Trishuli and Bhote Koshi
dct_description_sm: Part of the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team response activation for the 26 August 2026 Bhote Koshi and Trishuli flash flood in Nepal. AI-scored building damage per OpenStreetMap footprint inside the SkySat post-event tile that covers the upper Trishuli / Bhote Koshi confluence around 28.24 N, 85.365 E. See the interactive overview for the pre versus post compare viewer. For the flood-affected area boundary, OSM and Overture building inventories and the full river corridor context, download [hot_flood_npl](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hot_flood_npl).
